{"returnValue":{"/Script/DataflowAgent.DataflowGraphEditingSkill":"Skill for generating and editing Dataflow graphs (simulation / deformation nodes)","/PCGToolset/Skills/Skill_PCGGraphGeneration.Skill_PCGGraphGeneration_C":"Foundation skill for all PCG graph work, used for generating, editing, and using Procedural Content Generation (PCG) graphs. Use this skill whenever a task involves repeating patterns, rules, or batch operations on content in the level — such as scattering vegetation, generating roads, or populating any area following a definable system. PCG is NOT the right tool for one-off, unique placements that follow no repeatable rule. Beyond content generation, PCG is also the preferred tool for any spatial computation or organization task (distances, area subdivision, shape operations, point filtering) — its primitive nodes handle these operations natively and far more efficiently than reasoning about them manually.","/NiagaraToolsets/Python/skills/blueprint_interop_PY.NiagaraBlueprintInteropSkill":"Covers driving Niagara Systems from Blueprint at runtime -- spawn-mechanism choice, parameter binding, and pooling and lifetime.","/NiagaraToolsets/Python/skills/cleanup_PY.NiagaraCleanupSkill":"Covers inspecting a Niagara System for cleanup candidates -- orphaned modules, unused User Parameters, and leftover state after modifications -- and presenting them to the user before removal.","/NiagaraToolsets/Python/skills/custom_hlsl_PY.NiagaraCustomHLSLSkill":"Covers writing inline HLSL expressions in Niagara dynamic inputs -- single-rvalue syntax, CPU VM and GPU intrinsic compatibility, and Particle/Emitter/System scope rules.","/NiagaraToolsets/Python/skills/fundamentals_PY.NiagaraFundamentalsSkill":"Covers the foundational rules for authoring Niagara systems -- templates, sim target, script stack ordering, lifecycle and initialization, parameter namespaces, randomness, coordinate spaces, HLSL expressions, User Parameters, and materials.","/NiagaraToolsets/Python/skills/level_placement_PY.NiagaraLevelPlacementSkill":"Triggers when the user asks to place or spawn a gameplay VFX -- smoke, plume, fire, explosion, spark, trail, beam, muzzle flash, impact, burst, dust, cloud, ember, projectile, hit, ability, status effect. Enforces the search-present-confirm gate before placing an existing asset.","/NiagaraToolsets/Python/skills/optimization_PY.NiagaraOptimizationSkill":"Covers reducing the CPU and GPU cost of Niagara effects -- sim target, emitter consolidation, bounds, scalability and Effect Types, pooling, system-level cheap wins, particle-only mesh stripping, and burst spawning.","/NiagaraToolsets/Python/skills/renderers_PY.NiagaraRenderersSkill":"Covers choosing and configuring Niagara renderers -- per-type rules (Sprite, Mesh, Ribbon, Light, Decal, Component), source mode, sprite alignment, visibility-tag and mesh-variant differentiation, sort mode, and silent-failure material dependencies.","/EditorToolset/Python/editor_toolset/skills/blueprint_basics_PY.BlueprintBasicsSkill":"Provides guidance on creating and editing Blueprints in Unreal Engine.
Apply this skill whenever creating, modifying, or reviewing Blueprint assets.","/EditorToolset/Python/editor_toolset/skills/default_outdoor_lighting_PY.DefaultOutdoorLightingSkill":"Skill that is dedicated at adjusting the default outdoor lighting setup in Unreal.
Apply this skill whenever setting up or modifying outdoor lighting (sun, sky, clouds,
fog, exposure).","/EditorToolset/Python/editor_toolset/skills/material_basics_PY.MaterialBasicsSkill":"Provides guidance on working with Materials and MaterialInstances in Unreal Engine.
Apply this skill whenever creating, modifying, or choosing between Material assets.","/EditorToolset/Python/editor_toolset/skills/unreal_skill_best_practices_PY.UnrealSkillBestPracticesSkill":"Provides best practices for creating, updating, and reviewing skills in Unreal.
Apply this skill whenever creating, updating, or reviewing skills in Unreal.","/ConvAI/Skills/ConvaiActions.ConvaiActions_C":"Configure and implement Convai character actions with the Blueprint convenience components, including schemas, exact handlers, completion/reporting, reusable Convai Move To and Convai Escort tasks, cancellation, and opt-in experimental actions.","/ConvAI/Skills/ConvaiCharacterReference.ConvaiCharacterReference_C":"Mental model + index for building with Convai — the components and the systems they expose (setup, conversation, memory, actions, custom actions, scene objects, dynamic context, gaze, face/animation, narrative, vision, REST utilities), each pointing to its deep skill. Read first when configuring or extending a Convai character.","/ConvAI/Skills/ConvaiConversation.ConvaiConversation_C":"Character identity binding, the conversation pipeline lifecycle, session persistence/resumption, interrupt handling, and long-term memory via end-user identity. Use when wiring or debugging how a Convai chatbot starts/stops a conversation, remembers a player across sessions, or handles interrupts and failures. Covers the chatbot from BeginPlay through teardown.","/ConvAI/Skills/ConvaiCustomActions.ConvaiCustomActions_C":"Author custom and parameterized Convai actions on the Blueprint convenience chatbot, including exact named handlers, typed parameters, asynchronous task proxies, one-terminal completion ownership, and optional race-safe cancellation.","/ConvAI/Skills/ConvaiDynamicContext.ConvaiDynamicContext_C":"Author live context and spatial awareness with the right state/fact/event channel, response policy, conversation-idle delivery, flush behavior, batching, and movement-aware surroundings.","/ConvAI/Skills/ConvaiExpressiveness.ConvaiExpressiveness_C":"Quick reference for runtime character EXPRESSIVENESS on the Convai chatbot component (MetaHuman-only currently): look at / point at an actor, set facial emotion, natural in-conversation gestures (just enable actions), and play the plugin's shipped body animations. Use when a task is 'look at / face / emote / gesture / react expressively'. Short pointers to the deep skills (ConvaiActions, ConvaiGazeAttention, ConvaiFaceAndAnimation, ConvaiSimpleAnimationActions, ConvaiDynamicContext) rather than duplicating them.","/ConvAI/Skills/ConvaiFaceAndAnimation.ConvaiFaceAndAnimation_C":"How Convai drives facial lip-sync, body/face animation blueprints, and emotion-driven expression at runtime. Use when a character's mouth/face isn't moving, when adapting the face-sync node to a non-MetaHuman rig, when layering emotion under lip-sync, or when tuning expressiveness. Explains the voice-to-face pipeline, the AnimGraph node's tuning knobs, the shipped MetaHuman AnimBPs, and the emotion state flow. Setup steps live in ConvaiMetahumanSetup.","/ConvAI/Skills/ConvaiGazeAttention.ConvaiGazeAttention_C":"End-to-end guide for the Convai Gaze Attention system: how the player component detects gazed objects (line trace + angle/cone fallback), how sustained gaze promotes an object to the chatbot's attention slot, the three-way respond-on-attention choice, how the highlight actor and on-screen cursor work, explicit vs. gaze attention ownership, and per-object opt-outs. Covers gotchas around wall occlusion, merged-set collective highlighting, component-scoped gaze, destroyed-target cleanup, and UE version fallbacks.","/ConvAI/Skills/ConvaiMetahumanSetup.ConvaiMetahumanSetup_C":"Bring a MetaHuman and the player to a working Convai conversational setup — the right (Blueprint) components, the Convai face/body animation, character binding, lip-sync mode, and how to enable movement/follow. Use when first wiring a character for Convai.","/ConvAI/Skills/ConvaiNarrativeDesign.ConvaiNarrativeDesign_C":"Design and wire branching, trigger-driven stories using the Convai Narrative Design system: authoring sections and triggers on the dashboard, feeding template key/value data from Blueprint, firing triggers at runtime, and reacting to section-change events in UE5.","/ConvAI/Skills/ConvaiPlayerAndInput.ConvaiPlayerAndInput_C":"Sets up the Convai player side: mic capture, talk-mode (hold-to-talk vs always-streaming), player identity (PlayerName / EndUserID / metadata), session and normalized speaking lifecycle, microphone device selection, mute/VAD, and the ConvaiAudioCaptureComponent pipeline. Covers session auto-init on server connection, the bMute soft-mute flag, and platform mic-permission handling (Android). Does NOT cover gaze-attention (separate skill) or character/chatbot setup.","/ConvAI/Skills/ConvaiProjectSetup.ConvaiProjectSetup_C":"First-time Convai project setup and configuration: enabling the plugin, entering the API key through the Convai Editor UI (not Project Settings), what each plugin module does and the platform/cook gotchas, the project-level settings groups (spatial awareness, duplicate object names, VAD), and verifying the runtime is ready before any character can converse. Use for fresh installs and for diagnosing load/auth/packaging failures. Per-character Blueprint wiring is ConvaiMetahumanSetup.","/ConvAI/Skills/ConvaiQuickStart.ConvaiQuickStart_C":"Fastest path for a beginner request (talk + follow/move + a custom print OR simple animation action): call the Convai toolset tools (SetupConvaiCharacter/Player/PawnMovement, AddNavMeshVolumeForCurrentLevel, AddConvaiAction, CreateConvaiActionHandler) instead of hand-wiring components/graphs. Read this first for any Convai setup.","/ConvAI/Skills/ConvaiRestAndAudioUtilities.ConvaiRestAndAudioUtilities_C":"The standalone Convai REST/async Blueprint nodes and audio helper functions — outside the live conversation pipeline. Covers character management (create/update/get-details/list), available-voice listing, avatar-image download, one-shot text-to-speech and speech-to-text from sound/bytes/file, long-term-memory speaker-ID management, and the audio/file conversion utilities (stereo-to-mono, SoundWave↔WAV, byte-array I/O). Use when building tooling, character pickers, offline STT/TTS, or converting audio for Convai — not for normal in-game talking (that is ConvaiConversation/ConvaiPlayerAndInput).","/ConvAI/Skills/ConvaiSceneObjects.ConvaiSceneObjects_C":"Register scene objects and characters, expose live tracked state, configure movement awareness and its optional watchable Movement state, and control attention, merging, nearest-member movement targeting, authoritative arrival, and spatial inclusion.","/ConvAI/Skills/ConvaiSimpleAnimationActions.ConvaiSimpleAnimationActions_C":"Make a Convai character play a SIMPLE one-shot animation on command (clap, wave, cheer, bow, dance). Scriptable path: declare a no-parameter action, create the typed handler event (CreateConvaiActionHandler), then set the body in ONE write_graph_dsl call on the EventGraph that plays the AnimSequence on the Body via Get Anim Instance > Play Slot Animation as Dynamic Montage (slot 'DefaultSlot') and completes only AFTER the montage finishes (Delay = the located clip's SequenceLength, or bind OnMontageEnded when hand-wiring). NOT for complex motions needing state machines, root motion, IK targeting, or interaction with surroundings (pick up, sit, open door). See ConvaiCustomActions for the action mechanism and choice-driven variations.","/ConvAI/Skills/ConvaiVision.ConvaiVision_C":"Enables a Convai character to 'see' the world: covers the IConvaiVisionInterface, UConvaiWebcamBase, UEnvironmentWebcam (in-world scene-capture vision), how to attach a vision component to a character's audio streamer, EVisionState lifecycle (Start/Stop/Pause), FPS throttling, and the compressed/raw frame capture API. Does NOT cover gaze-attention or the player mic pipeline.","/PCGToolset/Skills/Skill_InstantLevelOperations.Skill_InstantLevelOperations_C":"Use for quick, fire-and-forget batch operations: spatial placement of actors, actor transforms, or batch assets creation, spline shape or lines directly in the level. No graph authoring required — results appear immediately. Use this before reaching for a full PCG graph when the task is self-contained.","/PCGToolset/Skills/Skill_PCGAssetZoo.Skill_PCGAssetZoo_C":"Skill for setting up an asset zoo (asset line-up) — a world-building workflow that places and organizes a curated set of assets in the level for environment artists to inspect, compare, and evaluate assets side by side. This skill is specifically using PCG graph template "Asset_grid_with_Frame"","/PCGToolset/Skills/Skill_PCGBiomeCore.Skill_PCGBiomeCore_C":"Skill for creating and configuring PCG BiomeCore biome systems, including BiomeDefinition, BiomeAsset, BiomeGenerator, BiomeFilter assets, and world actor placement, using the PCGBiomeCore plugin conventions.","/PCGToolset/Skills/Skill_PCGBiomeCoreRefinement.Skill_PCGBiomeCoreRefinement_C":"Structured debug checklist for diagnosing PCGBiomeCore silent failures — no assets spawning, zero points, or partial generation. Distilled from live debugging sessions against verified plugin internals.","/PCGToolset/Skills/Skill_PCGInstancingOnMeshActor.Skill_PCGInstancingOnMeshActor_C":"Instancing on Mesh Actors also called greeble effect. This skill is a more advanced workflow, and a guide to use the Scatter_points_onto_Mesh_Actor PCG graph template and should be used only when specifically called by the user. For regular PCG operations refer to other available PCG skills. ","/PCGToolset/Skills/Skill_PCGMeshPartition.Skill_PCGMeshPartition_C":"Skill for reading and writing PCG-driven 3D terrain (MeshPartition) — a geometry-based replacement for heightmap landscapes. Use when working with PriorityLayers, WeightChannels, or PCG graphs that deform or sample terrain topology.","/PCGToolset/Skills/Skill_PCGShapeGrammarDefinition.Skill_PCGShapeGrammarDefinition_C":"Skill for generating, editing and using the Shape Grammar Framework — PCG-driven procedural layout generation along splines using ShapeGrammarDefinition, Rule, and Module assets."}}
